addServices.title: Add Services
addServices.description: Create your service catalog with prices and durations. This helps clients understand what you offer and book appointments easily.

addStaff.title: Add Staff
addStaff.description: Add your team members so clients can choose their preferred master. Each staff member can have their own schedule and services.
addStaff.question: Do you perform services in the salon?

checkSchedule.title: Salon hours & calendar
checkSchedule.description: Set opening hours in Salon settings — that controls online booking slots. Use Calendar to see visits and block time off when you're closed or busy.

checkBookingPage.title: Check Booking Page
checkBookingPage.description: Preview how your salon appears to clients. Make sure all information is correct and the booking process works smoothly.

publishSalon.title: Publish Salon
publishSalon.description: Make your salon visible to clients. Once published, your salon will appear in search results and category listings.

salonPublishedSuccess: Your salon has been published and is now visible to clients!

photoTip.title: 💡 Tip to increase bookings
photoTip.description: Add salon photos to increase customer trust by 40% and bookings by 35%
